name: United States Marine Corps
description: Scarlet command headings, black body text, and gold rules from the Marines.mil style guide. Includes the Eagle, Globe, and Anchor and the MARINES wordmark.
disclaimer: Unofficial knowledge for educational use; not endorsed by the USMC or DoD.

guidance.typography: Headings are bold, uppercase, condensed display type in scarlet (#940000). Body text is Arial in black. Keep headings short and declarative.
guidance.illustration: Clean vector illustration with sharp silhouettes and disciplined composition. High contrast. Palette limited to black (#000000), scarlet (#940000), dark scarlet (#660000), white, neutral gray, and sparing gold (#84754E). Flat fills, no gradients, no photographic texture, plain white background. Do not draw text, lettering, insignia, emblems, rank devices, seals, or flags. Avoid cartoonish military aesthetics and busy backgrounds.
guidance.diagram: High-contrast technical diagram. White nodes with black outlines and square corners; scarlet fill only for the single most important node; black connectors with small arrowheads. Labels are short, sentence case, and never decorative.
guidance.caption: Small Arial caption in dark gray, sentence case, one line when possible.
guidance.border: Thin neutral gray border with square corners; no drop shadows.
guidance.icon: Font Awesome 5 Free, medium weight, used only to clarify meaning.
